faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AWEIL Executive Finance recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the AWEIL Executive Finance recruitment is 31 August 2026. Candidates are advised to send their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Executive Finance post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Executive Finance post, candidates must be a Chartered Accountant (CA) from ICAI or a Cost & Management Accountant (CMA) from ICMAI, with a minimum of 3 years of post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the Executive Finance position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Executive Finance position is 35 years. Age relaxations are applicable for SC/ST, OBC, and PWD candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Executive Finance role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Executive Finance post will receive a fixed salary of Rs. 90,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Executive Finance post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 9 vacancies announced for the Executive Finance post in Advanced Weapons and Equipment India (AWEIL).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post or as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for AWEIL Executive Finance recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the AWEIL Executive Finance recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Executive Finance role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Executive Finance role will be based on an interview. Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria will be shortlisted for the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of AWEIL, which is www.aweil.in. Links are also provided in the Important Links section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this AWEIL recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this AWEIL recruitment is contractual. Selected candidates will be appointed on a contractual basis.
